newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London steady in nervous trade.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London steady in nervous trade.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London were little changed in thin trade on Monday as investors chose to stay out of the market after a two percent fall in Tokyo overnight, traders said.
The Nikkei 50 index was at 1,313.23 points by 1457 GMT, up 0.68 points from Friday's close.
Traders said there was some downward pressure on shares but London investors were reluctant to get involved due to uncertainty about the direction of the Nikkei.
"You'd bet on it (the market) going down, but in the short-term it could easily fly up a couple of hundred points if the government came out and said the right things," one trader said.
The banking sector again took a blow with Mitsubishi Trust and Banking Corp under pressure after being heavily sold in Tokyo overnight, dealers said.
Toyota and Sony also came under pressure, they said.
The benchmark Nikkei average of 225 leading shares in Tokyo closed down 354.46 points at 17,334.90.
